name: CryptoVault-Pro
description: A production-grade Angular 21 application demonstrating resilient, offline-first cryptocurrency portfolio management with clean architecture and enterprise engineering practices.

paragraphs: Production-grade Angular 21 cryptocurrency portfolio tracker Clean architecture · Offline-first · Signal-driven state · Enterprise resilience
Live Demo · Documentation · Report a Bug · Request a Feature

CryptoVault Pro is a frontend system design case study — a reference implementation that demonstrates how to build resilient, scalable, offline-first Angular applications at a production level. Every layer from domain model to HTTP interceptor is engineered with real-world constraints in mind: rate-limited APIs, intermittent connectivity, strict performance budgets, and long-term maintainability.
features: Dashboard — Live market overview with global stats, trending coins, price charts, and grid/list toggle
Portfolio — Buy/sell transaction tracking with real-time P&L, ROI, portfolio allocation, risk score, diversification score, and rebalancing suggestions
Watchlist — Drag-and-drop reorderable watchlist with CDK virtual scrolling for large lists
Coin Detail — Full historical price charts (Lightweight Charts), on-chain metrics, and portfolio shortcut
Settings — Theme (dark/light), currency, locale, encryption toggle, data export/import
